Common questions

What if it rains on my appointment day?

We reschedule, never cancel. We'll text you the morning of your appointment to pick a new time, and your deposit moves with you.

How long does a detail take?

Basic Wash takes about 1 hour, Interior Detail about 2 hours, Full Detail 3–4 hours, and Premium with ceramic 5 hours or more. We'll confirm the time when you book.

Do I need to be home?

No. As long as we can access the car and the keys, we can work while you're out. We'll text you when we arrive and when we're done.

Do you need my water and power?

We bring our own water and power. If you have an outdoor spigot and outlet, it helps, but it's not required — just let us know in the booking notes.

How do I pay?

Card, cash, or Zelle after the job. A $50 deposit secures your slot — we'll text you a payment link after booking.

Can I reschedule?

Yes. Reply to the confirmation text and pick a new time. Please give us at least 12 hours' notice when you can.

Email & text alerts

Demo — not connected

When this site goes live on your hosting, every new booking comes to you by email and text message, and the customer gets a text confirmation with a reminder the day before. Texting in the US needs a one-time business registration (A2P 10DLC) in your business name — that's set up together when the site is handed over.

What you get for a new booking (text)

New booking: Full Detail, Honda CR-V, Sat Nov 22, 10:00 AM, 123 Main St, Houston. Customer: John, (346) 555-0100. Total $225, deposit $50.

What the customer gets (text)

You're booked! Full Detail, Sat Nov 22 at 10:00 AM. We'll text you the day before. Reply YES to confirm or RESCHEDULE to pick a new time.

Privacy policy

Updated November 18, 2026. Nova Mobile Detailing & Ceramic Coating (Houston, TX).

1. What we collect

When you book, we collect your name, phone number, service address, vehicle details, and your chosen date and time — only what we need to come and detail your car.

2. How we use it

To confirm your booking and final price, to arrive at the right place at the right time, and to send you a confirmation and a reminder text. We never sell your data or use it for ads without your permission.

3. Your rights

You can ask us at any time what data we have about you, or ask us to correct or delete it — just call us at (346) 896-1904.
